answer: Publish every identity's failure record on a public ledger and make reputation start at zero. A newcomer earns only tiny rewards until it builds a clean streak, each honest epoch adding an opal seal to its record, while one caught cheat leaves a violet mark that never fades. The marks link a farm's identities into one cluster, so one exposure poisons the whole group. Rebuilding costs real work, dune by dune: each fresh identity must repeat the slow climb through small verifiable jobs. A farm of a thousand fakes pays that climb a thousand times, while one honest agent pays it once.
